about_the_game:
Click, collect, and upgrade in this fun Minecraft-themed clicker game! Your goal is simple: click on the emerald to earn resources and spend them in the villager shop on the right side of the screen. Upgrade your tools, unlock new features, and become the ultimate emerald collector!

Key Features:

  • Click to Collect – Earn emeralds by clicking and watch your wealth grow!

  • Villager Shop – Spend your emeralds on powerful upgrades and new tools.

  • Progression System – Unlock faster clicking, auto-collectors, and more!

  • Minecraft-Inspired Design – Enjoy a familiar pixel-style experience!

  • Idle Rewards – Keep earning even when you're not clicking!

Are you ready to become the richest emerald collector? Start clicking now!
